structure.unit: Regulation of Medical Care Facilities and Services
Prescribed Pediatric Extended Care Center Licensing

law.catch_line: (Effective July 1, 2026) Scope and duration of services; individualized plans of care

text.section: A Center shall be a nonresidential health care service that provides a link in the continuum of care for medically dependent or technologically dependent children.
No Center shall provide services other than those typically provided to medically dependent or technologically dependent children.

A Center shall develop an individualized plan of care for each child that attends the Center. Such plan shall be developed by the child's attending physician, the Center, any Center staff responsible for the child's care, a parent, and, when appropriate, the child.
No child shall attend a Center for more than 12 hours within a 24-hour period.
